ideas.pitch: An overnight code review and automated regression remediation agent that intercepts pull requests, runs safety verification, and opens self-tested patches.
ideas.problem_statement: Developer Workflow track: Reviewing code and handling complex workflows autonomously without continuous human intervention.
ideas.title: NightOps DevGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the hackathon core challenge of leaving an agent running overnight, and applies the root-cause triage pattern seen in past winning debugging agents.

ideas.pitch: An email and calendar agent that parses incoming administrative chaos, cross-references calendar availability, drafts tentative bookings, and executes multi-step scheduling workflows.
ideas.problem_statement: Inbox & Calendar track: Managing emails and schedules from trigger to result with built-in safety guardrails.
ideas.title: InboxZero Autonomous Negotiator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies human-in-the-loop approval workflows which judges look for when evaluating autonomous reliability and safety guardrails.

ideas.pitch: A browser automation agent that autonomously navigates academic databases, extracts multi-page research documents, parses data tables, and compiles structured literature review notes.
ideas.problem_statement: Research & Study track: Conducting research, navigating websites, and handling complex external inputs reliably.
ideas.title: ScholarScout Web Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages robust browser automation with a clear termination condition so judges see an agent that knows when to stop rather than looping infinitely.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous life admin agent that handles multi-platform bookings, form fillings, and subscription cancellations by securely interacting with web interfaces using local MCP tools.
ideas.problem_statement: LifeAdmin track: Taking meaningful actions across real systems and external inputs without continuous human intervention.
ideas.title: LifeAdmin Executive Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes strict safety guardrails and explicit permission checkpoints, directly earning the safety bonus points outlined in the hackathon rules.

ideas.pitch: A general-purpose DOM-navigation agent that takes high-level user goals, converts them into secure browser actions, handles unexpected captchas or errors, and verifies task completion before stopping.
ideas.problem_statement: Browser Agent track: Navigating websites and executing complete workflows from trigger to result.
ideas.title: OmniDOM Browser Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the difficult reliability problem of web agents getting stuck in infinite loops by implementing a hard timeout and state validation monitor.
